title: Band schedule payload
description: Response of GET /api/v1/schedule. Keys are short on purpose: this travels over BLE to a watch.

v.description: Wire format version. Bump on any breaking change.

gid.description: Group id in the university system.

g.description: Group name, e.g. МБС-301-О-01. Null if upstream never reported one.

gen.description: When this response was generated, ISO 8601 with offset.

src.description: When the underlying snapshot was fetched from the university.

stale.description: True when the snapshot is older than two fetch intervals.

h.description: First 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over the canonical `days` JSON. Also the ETag.

days.description: Days that actually have lessons, ascending. May be empty: the university publishes only about ten days ahead.

l.description: Lessons of that day, ordered by pair number.

p.description: Pair number. Times are not transmitted; the watch has bells.json.

n.description: Subject name, abbreviated to fit the watch screen.

t.description: Lesson type: Лек, Прак, Лаб, Практ, Практика. May be empty if upstream omitted it.

r.description: Room as building-number, e.g. 4-101. Null when unknown (upstream 4-0).

tc.description: Teacher as surname plus initials. Null when upstream has none.

sg.description: Subgroup number, or null for a lesson the whole group attends.
